name: GoldenRetriever
description: Personal knowledge base with hybrid-search RAG chat and citations

paragraphs: Save anything from the web, then ask questions of your own library and get answers grounded in what you saved, with citations.
▶ Live demo: sign up for a free account to try it.

GoldenRetriever is a personal knowledge base with retrieval-augmented chat. You capture articles, PDFs, notes and bookmarks from the web app or your phone's Share Sheet. GoldenRetriever parses, chunks, embeds and auto-tags each item. When you ask a question, a hybrid search finds the most relevant passages and the model streams an answer that cites them. Click a citation to see the passage it came from.
features: Paste text, submit a URL (the server fetches and parses it), or drag and drop PDF/Office/image files.
iOS Share Sheet capture through an Apple Shortcut and a token-authenticated capture API (setup guide).
Bookmark import from a browser's exported HTML file. It shows progress for each item and a specific reason for each failure (unreachable, blocked, 404, rate-limited, …).
Ingestion pipeline: detects the format, extracts the content (Mozilla Readability for HTML, markitdown for binary documents), chunks it, embeds it and tags it with an LLM.
